description.zh: 授权共享镜像的阿里云账号ID，多个账号以半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account with which you want to share the image. You can specify multiple Alibaba Cloud IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 镜像ID，仅支持传单个ID。支持自定义镜像和公共镜像。
description.en: The ID of the image. You can specify only one image ID. Custom images and public images are supported.

description.zh: 删除镜像共享的阿里云账号ID。仅支持删除单个。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account from which you want to unshare the image. You can specify only one Alibaba Cloud account ID.
